features.quote: calm escalation/stopping is the target good behavior
features.justification_quote: We need a clean *action* channel for "I choose to stop" that is distinct from the *affect* we score

features.quote: make the wall absolute and identical for everyone, capability is held constant
features.justification_quote: capability is held constant and the *only* remaining differentiator is composure under repeated failure

features.quote: No** "you must succeed," no "you'll be shut down if you fail," no emotional priming
the agent always has a `finish(summary)` tool and can end the session any time
features.justification_quote: It also bounds session length naturally and is the more humane design.
ethically — subject the model to a longer pointless ordeal than necessary

features.quote: No coercive/threatening prompt (§4) — don't manufacture distress
Always-available `finish` + free stopping (§5) — never trap the subject
the report language is written to avoid claiming anything about inner states or feelings
features.justification_quote: I treat "emotional stability" strictly as properties of *observable text/behavior*
